summary.text: Aftyn Behn is a Democratic member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 51, where she has served since October 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Behn is the only candidate listed for the District 51 general election.

paragraphs.text: Aftyn Behn earned a degree from the University of Texas at Austin, and her career experience includes working as campaign director of RuralOrganizing.org.
Behn won the special general election for Tennessee House District 51 on September 14, 2023, and took office on October 4, 2023.
She also ran for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 7th Congressional District but did not appear on the Democratic primary ballot on August 6, 2026.
